author.heading: About Elizabeth Blackwell
author.bio: Blackwell was a physician who helped open medical education and practice to women. Her autobiography recounts that effort and the experiences she associated with choosing a medical career.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Blackwell describes the statement while looking back on her decision to enter medicine. The inspected 1895 autobiography establishes the writer, whereas calling the sentence an inspected 1845 diary entry would give the evidence an unwarranted form and date.
